description: This file defines the device model API for Zephyr RTOS, including device structures, macros for device creation and management, dependency handling, and functions for device lookup and status checks.

methods.name: device_handle_get
methods.description: Returns a handle for a given device, based on its position in the device section.

methods.name: device_from_handle
methods.description: Retrieves the device pointer associated with a given handle.

methods.name: device_required_handles_get
methods.description: Gets device handles for devicetree dependencies of a device.

methods.name: device_injected_handles_get
methods.description: Gets device handles for injected dependencies of a device.

methods.name: device_supported_handles_get
methods.description: Gets device handles for devices supported by a device.

methods.name: device_get_binding
methods.description: Retrieves a device pointer by its name.

methods.name: device_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if a device is ready for use.

methods.name: device_required_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over devices required by a given device.

methods.name: device_supported_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over devices supported by a given device.
